paragraphs.text:
Your  rifle  cracks  and  you  hear  a  high-pitched  squeal  like 
that  of  a  frightened  piglet.  Your  companions  struggle  from 
their bedrolls, all shouting at once. You explain that you shot 
something next to Bernard.

Charlie plucks a flaming brand from the fire and approaches 
the bewildered student. With a frown, she pauses over something 
in the bracken. She gasps and staggers back, shielding her face. 
You come up beside her, to see what you have hit.

It is a strange, diminutive figure, almost human, but with 
exaggerated, sculpted features. In the flickering light from the 
brand, its skin seems colorless, gray. It has very long fingers and 
odd feet, almost like hands.

“A puk-woogie!” Charlie grabs you. “This is an evil Little One 
of the Night! If there is one, there will be more! Professor, we must 
leave this valley!”

The figure is fascinating. But Charlie does not seem like 
a woman who is easily scared. The students look to you for 
a decision.

To argue with Charlie, go to 30. To agree with her, bury the little 
figure, and return downriver, go to 165.
